name: @office/domain-schedule
description: Office schedule/program-of-work domain module (OFF-010): the canonical, provider-independent Schedule aggregate (activities, FS/SS/FF/SF dependencies with lag, WBS-ish hierarchy, milestones, immutable baselines with a supersedes chain, append-only progress updates) with dependency-graph validation, deterministic CPM forecast calculation (forward/backward pass, total float, critical path) and current-vs-baseline variance — all pure domain, in-memory-testable, with injected clock/id suppliers. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, @office/events (the thin ledger-backed EventSink adapter) and @office/persistence (the SqlExecutor type of the mirrored EventSink port).
